from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialMetrics(BaseModel):
    """Financial metrics for one company's filing, capturing net income and operating cash flow."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the filing")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The period the report covers, in YYYY-MM format")
    net_income_amount: float | None = Field(description="Net income amount, signed (positive for income, negative for loss)")
    net_income_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale of net income: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    operating_cash_flow_amount: float | None = Field(description="Operating cash flow amount, signed (positive for provided, negative for used)")
    operating_cash_flow_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale of operating cash flow: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    net_income_label: str | None = Field(description="Line item label as written for net income")
    operating_cash_flow_label: str | None = Field(description="Line item label as written for operating cash flow")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_metrics: list[CompanyFinancialMetrics]
